title: Signal Translation & Scope Accelerator for Sales/CS Enterprise Requests
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: Create a lightweight, repeatable process and artifact set that Sales and Customer Success can use to submit, aggregate, and get an initial technical + product-level scoping response for enterprise feature asks. Goal: reduce initial turnaround from 2+ weeks to 48–72 hours for prioritized signals, provide a clear handoff package for Eng/Design, and surface obvious blockers (security, infra, legal) during first pass.

Scope: This ticket delivers a templated intake form, a 5-point scoring rubric (value, estimated effort, strategic fit, risk, urgency), a rapid synthesis cadence (daily/triage + weekly bundle), and a short tech-check checklist to catch blocking constraints (data residency, KMS, model compatibility). The output is a one-page "Handoff Snapshot" per cluster of similar asks plus an initial rough estimate (T-shirt sizing) and recommended next-step (POC, backlog, dedicated scoping workshop).

Who uses it: Sales AE, CS AE/CSM, Solutions Engineering for initial signal entry; PMs for prioritization and synthesis; Eng leads/arch for early feasibility checks; Design for UX-impact flags.

Components to deliver: 1) Google Form + Slack shortcut template for quick capture. 2) Aggregation spreadsheet with auto-tagging rules (account tier, revenue, ROI signal). 3) One-page Handoff Snapshot template (description, customer motivation, sample UX flow, acceptance criteria, initial constraints, suggested next step). 4) 5-point scoring rubric and working examples. 5) Runbook that defines SLA, who-tags, escalation path, and storage (Confluence link).

Risk & constraints: Must avoid manual heavy scoping for low-value asks — default to bundle and re-evaluate. Ensure privacy-sensitive asks include mandatory data handling field to flag Private deployment requirements. The form will explicitly ask whether the ask involves PHI, regulated data, or contractual SLA requests to trigger Legal/Security review.

Success metrics: - Average time from submission to Handoff Snapshot <= 72 hours for prioritized signals. - % of submitted asks with complete handoff package >= 85%. - Reduction in back-and-forth clarifying questions between Sales/CS and PM by 40% in first 2 months.

Out of scope: Deep engineering estimation, final design specs, project execution plan beyond initial scoping.
